95234842.title: File:Halloween displays in a Publix in Clearwater, Florida, Sep 2020.jpg

ImageDescription.value:
Halloween-themed displays in a Publix Super Market in Tri-City Plaza, Clearwater, Florida. The display in the foreground features small Halloween-themed jars, bowls, and decorations, including figurines shaped like ghosts. Also visible on this display are LED tea lights, pumpkin carving kits, and two pumpkins.

In the background, a display of Halloween candy can be seen. The brands of candy visible in this display include Brach's candy corn, M&M's, Reese's, Skittles and Starburst, Nerds, Trolli candy, Crunch bars, Butterfingers, Sour Patch Kids, Twizzlers, Jolly Ranchers, Hershey's chocolates, Milk Duds, Kit Kats, Heath bars, Whoppers, Snickers, and Swedish Fish. On top of the display are artificial spider decorations (that are larger than real spiders). Balloons reading "HAPPY HALLOWEEN!" can be seen, along with a balloon designed to look like a cartoonish skeleton.

Other things visible in this image include some checkout lanes; balloons featuring Mickey Mouse; a refrigerator containing Reign Total Body Fuel energy drinks; an endcap display, stocked with Tidy Cats cat litter and Meow Mix, at the end of an aisle; a side view of an orange display of Jelly Belly candy corn; and a display of Lay's chips.
